methodological_rigor.justification: Systematic review/meta-analysis of checkpoint inhibitor toxicity predictors. Search strategy and inclusion/exclusion criteria specified. Risk-of-bias assessment (tool type not stated in excerpt). Meta-regression analyses for biomarker associations. Limitations: heterogeneity in biomarker definitions/measurement may limit pooling; publication bias acknowledgment but mitigation strategies unclear.

clinical_relevance_loe.justification: Systematic review of cohort/RCT studies (LoE: 2a) identifying predictive biomarkers for ICI toxicity. Clinical relevance high: better toxicity prediction would enable patient selection and mitigation strategies. However, clinical implementation currently limited; biomarkers mostly investigational.

reporting_quality.justification: PRISMA systematic review framework; flow diagram, study characteristics tables, bias assessment documented. Gaps: protocol registration status unclear, supplementary materials access not confirmed, individual biomarker extraction criteria may lack standardization.

novelty_literature.justification: Summarizes known ICI toxicity biomarkers (neutrophil-to-lymphocyte ratio, inflammatory markers, tumor-specific factors). Meaningful but incremental contribution unless identifies novel biomarker combinations or predictive algorithms.

writing_presentation.justification: Systematic review organization clear. Methods and results systematically presented. Discussion appropriately contextualizes findings.

key_strengths: Addresses clinical need: ICI toxicity prediction enables better patient management
Systematic methodology: PRISMA-aligned review of biomarker-toxicity associations
key_concerns: Biomarker heterogeneity: diverse measurement methods/cutoffs limit pooling and clinical translation
Limited novelty: mostly synthesizes known biomarkers without identifying new predictive signatures
Clinical implementation gap: identified biomarkers remain largely research-only; validation in prospective clinical trials needed
chief_reviewer.rationale: Tier 3 paper: systematic review of ICI toxicity biomarkers requiring major revisions addressing standardization and clinical translation pathways.
